name: Operator
title: Reports, evidence and reviews
description: Work through customer reports and review held transfers

review.description: Record a reason. Keep evidence about the recipient separate from uncertainty about the data source.
review.reasonPlaceholder: E.g. The recipient already has a HOLD from 2 independent reports; the leak source is unknown...
review.flow: RECEIVED → IN_REVIEW → RESOLVED / DISMISSED. Final states cannot change.

description.pending: {transferId} is awaiting review. Funds are reserved, not debited.
description.approved: {transferId} was approved. Funds are still reserved, not sent.
description.rejected: {transferId} was rejected. The reserved funds were released.

decision.title: Decision for this transfer
decision.description: Approve or reject this transfer only. The recipient's global restriction does not change.
decision.reasonPlaceholder: E.g. The customer confirmed through an official channel that this is a valid payment...
decision.infoBody: Approve → READY: keeps the reservation and the {deadline} deadline; the customer must confirm again. Reject → REJECTED: releases the reserved funds exactly once.
decision.approvedBody: No money has been sent. {customer} must confirm again before {deadline} (original deadline). If the recipient gets a new restriction, the transfer returns to RISK_HELD.
decision.rejectedDone: Transfer rejected and reserved funds released (mock).

evidence.title: Source evidence

description.report: What the customer submitted. Check the source instead of accepting a generated conclusion.

empty.report: This report has no attached evidence.
empty.hold: The customer did not submit evidence for this transfer.

evidence.emptyHint: Evidence is optional for ordinary transfers.
evidence.openOriginal: Open the original image through an authenticated link · no public URL

textSource.transcription: Transcribed from the image · model-generated, may be wrong

investigation.title: Investigate with AI
investigation.description: One bounded, read-only run over sandbox data. The result is a suggestion to review, not a decision.
investigation.limits: Limits: {seconds} seconds · up to {models} model calls · {tools} tool uses. AI cannot move or cancel money, create restrictions or publish notices.
investigation.runningHint: AI is reading the data it is permitted to access. Results appear when the run finishes.
investigation.rerunHint: Each rerun uses a new request key and counts toward the quota.

related.title: Related reports ({count})
related.note: Similarity is a hypothesis, not proof of the same fraudster.

trace.title: Reference trace

status.MATCHED_SCOPE: {count, plural, one {# code matched} other {# codes matched}} · narrows the investigation scope
status.NO_MATCH: No code matched an issuance record
status.NO_REFERENCE: The evidence has no reference code to trace

trace.candidates: {count, plural, one {# candidate customer has} other {# candidate customers have}} orders in {batch}

investigation.citationWarnings: {count, plural, one {# citation without a valid source was} other {# citations without a valid source were}} removed from the result.

decision.title: Recipient decision
decision.description: Create or revoke a restriction. Decisions are separate from AI suggestions.
decision.none: This recipient has no active restriction.
decision.warn: WARN – warn customers before they transfer
decision.footnote: A recipient has at most one active restriction. Revoking or creating records a new audited decision; nothing is overwritten.

notice.title: Notice preview
notice.description: Check who will receive the notice before publishing.

notInvestigated.title: Notice scope not determined yet
notInvestigated.hint: Run Investigate with AI in the Investigation tab to trace the related data batch.

noScope.title: No data batch to notify
noScope.hint: The investigation did not trace any reference code.

notice.audience: {count, plural, one {# customer} other {# customers}} with orders in {batch} will be notified
notice.derivedFrom: The server derives recipients from the traced batch ({batch}).

locked.title: Mark the report RESOLVED before publishing
locked.hint: Use the "Resolve" button at the top of the page.

dismissed.title: Report dismissed
dismissed.hint: Notices are not published for dismissed reports.

notice.confirm: Publish this notice to {count, plural, one {# customer} other {# customers}} as one batch?
notice.published: Notice published to {count, plural, one {# customer} other {# customers}} (mock).
